Percentage spacing expression cache: performance repair
Recorded 2026-11-02

Mixed stylesheet spacing expressions are parsed once with Lightning CSS and
shared during element styling. Font-dependent conversion still runs per element.
Literal percentages need no retained AST. Inline/substituted values retain the
native element-local path. Raw spacing uses the existing raw-property dispatch.
Lightning CSS remains unchanged and the only CSS parser.

Validation

Fresh before/after audit: 16,467 / 18,469 pass (89.16%), exactly the same 2,002
mismatch keys, 13,434 unrepresented assertions, zero dependency parser panics.
No test selections, expectations, existing tests or benchmark code changed.
304 style tests pass; one pre-existing font-metric test fails identically in
both rebuilt versions (letter_spacing(): observed 0.0, expected 3.0). Another
32 declaration-validation and five reader font-scaling tests pass; cargo check
passes. No image suite was rerun.

Performance

Both versions apply the same spacing features and share freshly rebuilt current
support crates. Existing benchmark sources unchanged. Ten cases, 15 alternating
pairs, 300 processes pinned to CPU 6. opt-level=2, debuginfo=0. Uncontrolled
host boost/frequency/load; diagnostic 95% bootstrap intervals, 5,000 resamples,
no multiple-comparison adjustment. EPUB totals sum five fixture medians.
Cold means uncached author programs with machine/default CSS caches warmed.
Positive means slower. An interval containing zero is inconclusive.

Workload                         Paired change    95% bootstrap range    Assessment
cascade-plain                      -1.64%    [  -2.15%,   -1.26%]   speedup
cascade-vars-inline                -2.77%    [  -3.40%,   -1.81%]   speedup

The first implementation also scanned uncached declarations while linking.
It measured +1.68% normalization-retry time; a 30-run repeat measured +3.35%.
The final implementation skips this scan for fragments without cached values.
All 300 initial and 30 repeat runs remain alongside the 300 final runs.
The primary table above describes the final implementation only.
The cache trades retained native AST/map memory for less repeated parser work.
Cached-run counters start after warmup and exclude already retained cache
memory. An unchanged cached peak does not establish zero retained-memory cost.
Every timing, allocation and peak-byte observation is retained in the JSON
performance artifact and raw runs, including negative or inconclusive results.

Unrelated font-metric work was already present in the workspace at the start
of this change. Both baseline and current style were rebuilt against the same
freshly frozen support crates. Older saved libraries are incompatible with that
source graph and were excluded from the primary comparison. The historical
+6.09% plain-cascade finding is retained in spacing-fix-report.txt; this cache
comparison alone does not establish its removal.

Historical registry evidence is unchanged. There are still 234 fixed records,
178 confirmed dependency blocks and 1,824 unresolved records among the 2,236
original observations. Sources, compiler commands, package verification and
validation provenance are in spacing-cache-report.json. Builds stay on disk.
